items.author: colincarlson.bsky.social
items.context: Can you play Stardew Valley wrong? Am I playing it wrong? How would I know if I’m playing Stardew Valley wrong
items.text: I don't think there's a wrong way. Nothing really punishes you for ignoring the farm for a while and just fishing or chatting with villagers, so it's easy to play at your own pace.

items.author: astridindigo.bsky.social
items.context:
Who are your Stardew Valley big four? 1. Who you most often romance 2. Non-romanceable but you would if you could 3. Who would be your bestie 4. Who you despise to an irrational degree Mine are 1. Sebastian 2. Clint (or Jodi) 3. Leah (weirdo artist, duh) 4. Harvey (don’t SAY that to your patients)
4 images: Sebastian from SDV / Clint from SDV / Leah from SDV / Harvey from SDV
items.text: Leah is a lovely bestie pick. Her little cabin by the forest and the art she makes fit the calm side of the town perfectly.
